name: blink-clip-downloader-e2e
description: Playwright checks for the Blink Clip Downloader Vue web UI (frontend/). smoke.mjs is invoked by scripts/smoke-test.sh and CI's smoke-test job; signin_smoke.mjs by CI's signin-smoke-test job (the image with its shipped default, sign-in on); verify.mjs is ad-hoc dev/AI tooling for taking UI screenshots, not run in CI.
